Needs a look (imported)
-----------------------
1. db2 (Ping)
   Its active checks were turned off in Nagios, so it is imported paused.
   To do: Resume it when you want it checked.
2. dmz-noaddr (Ping)
   It has no address in Nagios; its name is checked instead.
3. Channel "alice"
   The pager number (15550001111) was not carried over.
   To do: Add an SMS or voice channel for it.
4. core-sw1 / Passive trap (Push) → core-sw1-passive-trap
   It only received passive results in Nagios; here it waits for results sent to
   its push URL (1h without one is a failure).
   To do: Have the sender call the push URL shown on the monitor
          (…/api/push/TOKEN?status=up|down&msg=…) instead of NSCA or NRDP.
5. web1 / Restart on failure (TCP port) → web1-restart-on-failure
   Its event handler runs restart-app.sh.
   To do: Copy that script into the check-scripts directory.
6. Script checks: check_nrpe
   These checks run Nagios plugins, so they are imported paused: Unagikuma only
   runs plugins from its check-scripts directory.
   To do: Copy the plugins into <data>/check-scripts (for example from
          /usr/lib/nagios/plugins), then resume the checks in the web interface.

Not imported
------------
1. Contact "carol"
   Why: It has no e-mail address.
   To do: Add a channel for this person (SMS, chat or e-mail) under Alerting ›
          Channels.
2. ghost-host / Orphan
   Why: Host ghost-host is not defined.
   To do: Nothing to do if that host is gone; otherwise add the check by hand.
3. web2 / Uses undefined command
   Why: The command check_foo is not defined.
   To do: Add the check by hand.
4. web2 / Unknown macro
   Why: It uses $_HOSTSITE$, but host web2 has no _SITE custom variable.
   To do: Add the check by hand.
5. web2 / Uses resource macro
   Why: It uses $USER2$, which is not set in the resource file.
   To do: Add the check by hand.
6. Time period "holidays-excluded"
   Why: No imported contact uses it.
   To do: Nothing to do, or add a PERIOD record when a channel needs one.
7. Definitions: 1 × define serviceescalation
   Why: Escalations were not converted.
   To do: Add escalate= to the policy, for example escalate=30m:manager
          (Alerting › Policies).
8. Definitions: 1 × define hostextinfo
   Why: Icons and extra host information are not used here.
   To do: Nothing to do.

Duplicates (imported once)
--------------------------
- web2 / HTTPS shop is the same check as web1-https-shop
- mail1 / SMTP is the same check as mail1

Good to know
------------
- Hosts become ping checks (or their own check command); their services depend
  on them, so a host that is down does not page for each service.
- Flap detection, freshness checks, performance data and acknowledgement
  settings have no direct equivalent and were not copied.
- Past states and history stay in Nagios: history starts fresh here.
- E-mail channels send through the local mail server (localhost:25) like Nagios
  usually does; change host= and from= under Alerting › Channels if needed.
